# Synthetic fixtures

All fixtures were generated for this project, without recorded speech, music or
third-party media, by the pinned @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 in Chromium.

`tests/codec-smoke.py --generate` runs `sine=frequency=440:duration=2:sample_rate=48000`
through `aac` (MP4/M4A), `libopus` (OGG/Opus), or `libvorbis` (OGG).
`silent.mp4` uses `color=c=blue:s=32x32:d=2`, MPEG-4 video, no audio.
The MP4 fixture additionally includes a synthetic 32×32 blue MPEG-4 video track
to exercise audio extraction.
Generated bytes can vary with encoder/container metadata; functional assertions
check decode, duration, audio-only output and bitrate, not a byte-for-byte hash.

Run the dev server, then `python tests/codec-smoke.py --generate` to regenerate.
The normal browser suite reads the committed fixtures, without native FFmpeg.
